interest: State redirected an Ohio student's 1931 request for Japan's anthem to the Japanese Embassy.
overview: Erma Barnhart of East Liverpool, Ohio, asks for Japan's national anthem in October 1931; Maxwell M. Hamilton replies that State has none and refers her to the Japanese Embassy.

people.name: Maxwell M. Hamilton
people.role: Assistant Chief, Division of Far Eastern Affairs

subfiles.about: A public inquiry from Miss Erma Barnhart requesting information and material regarding the national anthem of Japan.
subfiles.summary: Erma Barnhart asks the State Department for material on Japan, read as a request for the national anthem; received October 23, 1931.
subfiles.title: Letter from Erma Barnhart requesting the National Song of Japan

subfiles.about: The Department of State informs Miss Barnhart that it has no copies of the Japanese national anthem and refers her to the Japanese Embassy in Washington.
subfiles.summary: Maxwell M. Hamilton tells Erma Barnhart the Department has no copies of Japan's national anthem and suggests the Japanese Embassy.
subfiles.title: Letter from Maxwell M. Hamilton to Erma Barnhart regarding the Japanese national anthem
